title: TS-49 Make the real_web_workspace harness actions real
description:
Source: the re-audit report at /tmp/ts/reaudit.md plus the agent reports quoted here. Rules: features stay the spec (existing scenario text unchanged); cucumber-js steps drive production code; mutation check recorded per scenario group; no new Python; push with an explicit refspec.

From TS-46: in web/test-support (real-workspace-harness.ts) the actions select, send, reload, accessibility and inspector echo or sort their input or return constants, and the step 'the inspector shows the stopped computer and policy' compares a Given to itself. The computer panel is inline JSX in EnabledWorkspace.tsx, so there is no function to call. Extract the pure logic from the web components (the inspector and computer panel state, send, select, reload and accessibility ordering) into functions in web/lib that the components use and the harness calls, so each scenario fails when the production logic is broken. Keep the Gherkin unchanged; mutation-check each scenario group of real_web_workspace and report any that cannot fail. Same for web_task_list if not already real (TS-44 covers it; coordinate by checking origin/develop first).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged via PR 448. real_web_workspace drives extracted web/lib logic; web_task_list uses TS-44's harness (one implementation). Roster state texts lost trailing ellipsis/period (feature text is the spec). Accessibility scenario checks shared constants plus a unit test over the component buttons.

right_now_summary: The harness now drives extracted production logic, with shared task-list coverage and updated accessibility checks.
